# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Graphite GPU backend and performance**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 adds the Graphite GPU backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, plus async pixel readback. A new `SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET` package ships alongside the Graphite bindings. Performance gets two targeted fixes: `SKData.SaveTo` avoids a double buffer copy and uniform lookups in `SKRuntimeEffectUniforms` are pre-sized. Skia m151 upstream stability fixes are also included.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m151 upstream stability fixes** — The bundled engine picks up two rounds of upstream chrome/m151 bug fixes and a submodule sync. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend — Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn** — New managed bindings expose Skia's next-generation Graphite rendering backend with contexts for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, alongside a new `SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET` package that wires Graphite Vulkan to the Silk.NET interop layer. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968), [#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))
- **Async pixel readback on SKImage and SKSurface** — `RequestReadPixels` is a backend-neutral async API that lets callers read pixels off the GPU without blocking the render thread. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKImage.Create raster pixel-buffer leak fixed** — A `CoTaskMem`-allocated pixel buffer was leaked when the raster image creation path failed; the allocation is now correctly freed on the failure path. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKData.SaveTo avoids double buffer copy** — The `SaveTo` path now writes directly from the native buffer, eliminating an intermediate managed copy that doubled peak memory usage for large data objects. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))
- **SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map pre-sized** — `SKRuntimeEffectUniforms` now pre-sizes its internal uniform-name map to the known count, avoiding repeated rehashing on first use in hot render loops. ([#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))
- **GetEncodedText avoids string allocation in null-terminated path** — The fast path for null-terminated text no longer allocates an intermediate string, reducing GC pressure in text-heavy rendering. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498))

## Platform

- **FreeType font support on Nano Server** — Nano Server containers gain font rendering through FreeType, enabling server-side text layout in minimal Windows container environments. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server test coverage** — Containerized test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Nano Server are now part of the CI matrix, widening platform validation. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
